name: Energy Source Partners
old_description: Let us show you how to make the switch to clean power through solar financing solutions tailored to your unique needs.
about:
Energy Source Partners was founded in 2010 in Nashville, Tennessee. The company operates from an office at 2505 21st Avenue South, Suite 202, in the city's Music Row area. No information about the founders or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The firm provides commercial and residential solar panel systems, along with financing solutions tailored to individual project requirements. It also offers a production monitoring service that continuously tracks system performance to verify correct operation. The company does not disclose its headcount, facility size, or annual installation volumes.

Energy Source Partners serves both business and homeowner markets. Its commercial clients include companies seeking to reduce energy costs through solar installations, while residential customers are homeowners looking to switch to clean power. The company does not name specific clients or industry verticals beyond the broad commercial and residential categories.

The company states that its financing solutions are designed to make the switch to clean power straightforward, and that its monitoring service ensures systems run correctly. No further details about its founding mission or competitive differentiation are provided.
